desc: display information about a network interface
r: pifconfig - display information about a network interface
This script mimic ifconfig behavior, but is written purely in python and python module ethtool.

<dl><dt>INTERFACE</dt><dd>Display information about only the listed interfaces. If no interface is given all interfaces are displayed.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-h, --help</dt><dd>Show help message and exit.</dd></dl>
